ache.title: “What brought me back” is exactly the hook, Nero
ache.note: Why does Genshin keep drawing him back? The colorful world, the nostalgia, even Hoyoverse’s response to Neuvillette’s charge attack fix. Nostalgia is real, and the loop knows how to use it. When a game you left keeps calling, it’s worth asking: is it the world I miss, or the pulls?
watch: nostalgia used as a return hook
ache.tip: When a game calls you back, revisit it for a week with no spending, then see if the fun is still there.
lines: coming back is the loop’s favourite trick
miss the world, or miss the pulls?
he left for real later. good boy. don’t quote me

title: What Brought Me Back to... | Genshin Impact
excerpt: In this video, I share my thoughts on Genshin Impact and why it continues to draw me back. I recount the fun situation with Neuvillette's charge attack fix and Hoyoverse's surprising response. I compare Genshin Impact to other games like Wuthering Waves and highlight what makes Genshin special to me, from its colorful world to its nostalgic atmosphere. Join me as I discuss my personal experiences, the game's endgame content, and my enduring love for this immersive world.
